import urllib.request

def deliver(event: dict, url: str) -> int:
    # allow customer-provided endpoints
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=json_dumps(event), method="POST")
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5) as r:
        return r.status
